notes.title: Fist update
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Thank you all for your support and feedback. The game turned out to be quite raw, I and I apologize to users who bought it and received less positive emotions than planned.
 Less than a month has passed since the start of the release, and now I have prepared a patch that will significantly improve the game component.
List of changes.
1) Greatly improved the visual part of the game, the models and the overall visual performance of the levels.

Developer comments: The game was made in a rather minimalistic style, few object models and so on. This has been improved.

2) Removed and improved interface.

Developer comments: Some icons were stylistically inconsistent with the game's style and were removed.

3) The overall difficulty of the game has been increased.

Developer comments: The game turned out to be quite simple and ran in 7-10 minutes. Presenting no challenge or interest to the user. The difficulty of the game has been increased. The levels have been improved.

4) Removed minor bugs related to the simultaneous appearance of the victory and defeat menu.

Future plans.
Working with light is a big failure.
It is planned to continue working on the levels, and improving them both from the visual and from the game part.
Adding special effects, and various particle systems.
Adding a plot in the form of small video inserts.
Adding various Easter eggs.
Support for Steam Achievements and Saving.

Once again I would like to thank everyone who is interested in this project. I do it alone so I can't do everything perfectly at once. Thank you for understanding.
